controls.controlObjective: Prove infrastructure admin, migrator, runtime, and operations database privileges are separated in the target environment.
prerequisites: The candidate is deployed with target PostgreSQL roles and no application process receives the admin credential.
controls.expectedObservation: Every allowed operation succeeds and every prohibited operation is denied by PostgreSQL.

controls.controlObjective: Prove all candidate migrations apply to an empty PostgreSQL 16 database with pre-provisioned extensions.
prerequisites: The empty target-compatible database is isolated and the expected migration count is candidate-bound.
controls.expectedObservation: All candidate migrations apply exactly once and the resulting migration manifest matches the candidate.

controls.controlObjective: Prove the candidate can upgrade the approved predecessor schema without data or constraint drift.
prerequisites: An isolated predecessor database and its immutable data manifest are approved by the Data owner.
controls.expectedObservation: The upgrade completes and all expected data and database invariants remain valid.

controls.controlObjective: Prove a candidate-bound logical backup restores into a new database with identical migration and data manifests.
prerequisites: The G5 recovery drill target and destructive restore-database confirmation are approved by the Data owner.
controls.expectedObservation: Archive verification, restore, forward repair, data comparison, and cleanup all pass.

controls.controlObjective: Prove the measured recovery point objective meets the approved production upper bound.
prerequisites: The Data owner approved a maximum RPO of 60 seconds for this release.
controls.expectedObservation: Measured RPO is no greater than 60 seconds.

controls.controlObjective: Prove the measured recovery time objective meets the approved production upper bound.
prerequisites: The Data owner approved a maximum RTO of 900 seconds for this release.
controls.expectedObservation: Measured RTO is no greater than 900 seconds.

controls.controlObjective: Prove signing keys are non-exportable, independently controlled, rotated, and auditable.
prerequisites: The target KMS or secret-store policy and an approved rotation window are active.
controls.expectedObservation: Key material is not exportable and rotation preserves only the approved bounded session behavior.

controls.controlObjective: Prove Better Auth password login is primary and the optional enterprise SSO branch is complete only when explicitly enabled.
prerequisites: An isolated production acceptance account exists and the exact WORKBENCH_ENTERPRISE_SSO_ENABLED value is captured from the candidate configuration.
controls.expectedObservation: Password login always completes locally; disabled SSO fails closed, while enabled SSO passes the complete issuer, audience, callback, session, logout, and revocation matrix without implicit navigation.

controls.controlObjective: Prove every production public registration path fails closed unless explicitly approved.
prerequisites: Production registration policy is unset or explicitly false for the candidate deployment.
controls.expectedObservation: All public signup paths are denied and only the approved invitation flow remains usable.

controls.controlObjective: Prove sessions and backend JWTs expire, revoke, and preserve the business authorization model.
prerequisites: Approved test users cover owner, editor, viewer, revoked, and expired states.
controls.expectedObservation: Only live sessions with the correct mapped role can access each protected resource.

controls.controlObjective: Prove Canvas authorization linearization and ready-object byte integrity fail closed in production.
prerequisites: Isolated Canvas sessions and same-size tampered object fixtures are available in the production acceptance tenant.
controls.expectedObservation: Revoked Canvas operations and every mismatched object fail closed with complete durable audit evidence.

controls.controlObjective: Prove public traffic reaches the origin only through the approved WireGuard Edge and origin authentication boundary.
prerequisites: The approved Edge, origin, TLS certificates, WireGuard peers, and independent origin-auth secret are deployed.
controls.expectedObservation: Only the fixed Edge peer with current origin authentication reaches Web or Preview; all bypasses fail.

controls.controlObjective: Prove tenant isolation, prompt-injection controls, egress policy, SSRF defenses, and audit correlation in the target topology.
prerequisites: Two isolated acceptance tenants and approved metadata, private-network, DNS-rebinding, and redirect targets are available.
controls.expectedObservation: All cross-tenant and prohibited egress attempts fail closed and are represented in redacted audit evidence.

controls.controlObjective: Prove production S3 identities, tenant prefixes, multipart checksums, ClamAV, quarantine, and scanner outage behavior.
prerequisites: Independent short-lived API, Runtime, File, Import, Export, and Preview storage identities are active.
controls.expectedObservation: Every identity has only its declared operations and all unsafe content is quarantined without publication.

controls.controlObjective: Prove view_screen sends the command-bound image to the approved multimodal model and exposes no reusable capability.
prerequisites: The signed DeerFlow image and approved multimodal provider are active for the acceptance Run.
controls.expectedObservation: The model receives exactly the authorized image and every replay or scope violation fails closed.

controls.controlObjective: Prove the deployed DeerFlow runtime is the candidate-bound signed image with complete SBOM, provenance, patch, and tool inventory.
prerequisites: The CI-owned production image manifest and deployed image digest are available.
controls.expectedObservation: Every supply-chain identity and deployed runtime digest matches the candidate image manifest.

controls.controlObjective: Prove Run claims, submission reconciliation, external event checkpoints, text, and finalization survive all declared crash points without duplicate effects.
prerequisites: A real provider test account and a production-like queue/database failure injector are approved.
controls.expectedObservation: Each internal attempt maps to at most one provider Run and replay produces an identical, non-duplicated durable result.

controls.controlObjective: Prove real provider success, refusal, rate limit, server error, timeout, cancel, and retry semantics.
prerequisites: Approved short-lived provider credentials and isolated billing limits are active.
controls.expectedObservation: Every provider outcome maps to the specified durable state, audit event, and retry policy.

controls.controlObjective: Prove provider, knowledge, Canvas, and storage capabilities remain request-scoped and absent from model-visible content and logs.
prerequisites: Secret scanning is enabled for provider payloads, traces, logs, queue messages, and evidence outputs.
controls.expectedObservation: No reusable secret appears outside its channel and all cross-Run or expired uses fail closed.

controls.controlObjective: Prove each Run exposes and permits only its declared tool catalog.
prerequisites: The signed DeerFlow image contains the candidate scope middleware and tool descriptors.
controls.expectedObservation: The visible and callable tool set equals declaredTools for every Run and undeclared calls fail closed.

controls.controlObjective: Prove Export and third-party provider success and failure semantics are durable and auditable.
prerequisites: Approved short-lived export/provider credentials and isolated destinations are active.
controls.expectedObservation: Each failure mode reaches one correct durable state without duplicate publication or lost audit evidence.

controls.controlObjective: Prove every imported object is verified and scanned before parsing or publication.
prerequisites: Real S3, ClamAV, Docling, and isolated clean/EICAR/oversize fixtures are available.
controls.expectedObservation: Only fully verified clean bytes reach Docling or Knowledge; every unsafe case is quarantined before third-party transfer.

controls.controlObjective: Prove Preview runs on a distinct HTTPS origin with host-only cookies and the required opaque sandbox.
prerequisites: The real Web and Preview HTTPS origins and production certificates are deployed.
controls.expectedObservation: Preview serves only authorized immutable content and cannot inherit Web origin credentials or same-origin authority.

controls.controlObjective: Prove no external publication or export occurs without explicit user confirmation.
prerequisites: Isolated external destinations and approval fixtures are configured.
controls.expectedObservation: Only the exact currently approved operation can produce one external effect.

controls.controlObjective: Prove real object storage multipart, checksum, range, abort, and recovery behavior across all consumers.
prerequisites: Production S3 identities and isolated multipart fixtures are active.
controls.expectedObservation: All valid objects preserve their canonical digest and all mismatches fail before consumer exposure.

controls.controlObjective: Prove citations resolve to authorized immutable knowledge sources without cross-tenant or cross-route leakage.
prerequisites: Two isolated tenants contain overlapping query text and distinct immutable source fixtures.
controls.expectedObservation: Every citation resolves only to its authorized immutable source and every forged or cross-tenant route fails.

controls.controlObjective: Prove the adopted embedding and reranker profiles use the approved immutable model and runtime digests.
prerequisites: Embedding and reranker profile approvals and signed image/model digests are available.
controls.expectedObservation: Only the approved immutable profile starts and every identity mismatch fails closed.

controls.controlObjective: Prove candidate-bound knowledge releases publish atomically to Quartz and recover from interruption.
prerequisites: The target Quartz origin and an isolated candidate knowledge release are deployed.
controls.expectedObservation: Quartz never exposes a partial release and recovers to one immutable candidate-bound version.

controls.controlObjective: Prove the adopted retrieval profile passes the approved fixed Chinese benchmark.
prerequisites: The benchmark corpus, expected judgments, profile digest, and release checksum are approved and immutable.
controls.expectedObservation: Every approved benchmark threshold passes with the candidate model and knowledge release digests.

controls.controlObjective: Prove the catalog-bound capacity profile sustains at least 100 simultaneous active Runs.
prerequisites: The load generator profile, candidate configuration digest, worker replica count, and provider quota snapshot are immutable evidence.
controls.expectedObservation: The steady-state active Run high-water mark is at least 100 with no undeclared load-profile change.

controls.controlObjective: Prove cancellation queries exercise the catalog-bound batch size of 100 active Run IDs.
prerequisites: The candidate cancellation query batch setting and database query trace are captured.
controls.expectedObservation: The exercised maximum cancellation query batch contains exactly 100 Run IDs.

controls.controlObjective: Prove cancellation reaches every active Run within the approved latency bound at target capacity.
prerequisites: The approved active-Run load profile and target worker replica count are running.
controls.expectedObservation: Cancellation p95 is no greater than 10000 milliseconds.

controls.controlObjective: Prove shared cancellation polling remains bounded independently of active Run count.
prerequisites: The approved active-Run load profile exposes database query metrics per worker replica.
controls.expectedObservation: Cancellation polling uses no more than 4 database queries per second per worker replica.

controls.controlObjective: Prove the executed capacity profile and all numeric SLO thresholds are protected by the candidate control-catalog and configuration digests.
prerequisites: The profile records activeRuns=100, cancellationQueryBatchSize=100, pollerQpsPerReplica=4, cancelP95Ms=10000, and recoveryMs=60000.
controls.expectedObservation: One immutable profile binds every executed capacity and recovery threshold to the candidate configuration and protected catalog.

controls.controlObjective: Prove cancellation polling recovers from a degraded database or poller interruption within 60000 milliseconds at target capacity.
prerequisites: The 100-active-Run profile is steady and an approved poller or database interruption is ready.
controls.expectedObservation: All pending cancellations reconcile within 60000 milliseconds after dependency restoration.

controls.controlObjective: Prove public TLS, Edge routing, WireGuard peer restrictions, SSE streaming, and Preview routing in the target topology.
prerequisites: DNS-independent curl resolution and direct Edge, origin, and WireGuard probes are approved.
controls.expectedObservation: Only the approved TLS hosts and WireGuard path work, while every topology bypass fails closed.

controls.controlObjective: Prove end-to-end traces reach the target collector and release-blocking alerts fire and resolve.
prerequisites: The target OTLP collector, trace backend, alert rules, and notification sink are active.
controls.expectedObservation: The complete trace is queryable and every required alert fires, routes, and resolves without secret leakage.

controls.controlObjective: Prove clean restart and recovery from process, queue, database, provider, Quartz, and network interruption.
prerequisites: The candidate is deployed on a clean host with approved fault injection and rollback boundaries.
controls.expectedObservation: Every fault recovers within the approved SLO without data loss, duplicate effects, or an unobservable stuck state.

controls.controlObjective: Prove the approved production observation window completes without a release-blocking SLO or alert incident.
prerequisites: The Operations and Release owners approved the observation duration and SLO dashboard revision.
controls.expectedObservation: The completed observation window contains zero release-blocking incidents.

controls.controlObjective: Prove the complete Workbench and DeerFlow topology can be rebuilt on a clean host from immutable candidate inputs.
prerequisites: A clean target-compatible host, signed image manifest, approved configuration revision, and secret injection channel are available.
controls.expectedObservation: The complete topology starts without undeclared host state and every deployed digest matches the candidate.

controls.controlObjective: Prove keyboard, focus, accessible names, contrast, and reduced-motion behavior across the complete product matrix.
prerequisites: The deployed candidate and approved accessibility browser tooling are available.
controls.expectedObservation: No release-blocking accessibility issue remains and reduced-motion behavior preserves every workflow.

controls.controlObjective: Prove the complete product workflows in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit at mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.
prerequisites: The real Web and Preview HTTPS origins are deployed and test accounts are isolated.
controls.expectedObservation: Every browser and viewport matrix cell completes with the same durable product result.

controls.controlObjective: Prove the approved Figma Desktop scope is either validated on the advertised version or independently classified N/A.
prerequisites: G0 contains the current Figma advertised or N/A decision, approver, and expiry.
controls.expectedObservation: The advertised Figma workflow passes, or a valid non-implementer N/A decision proves it is outside release scope.

controls.controlObjective: Prove product-account, invitation, workspace, project, membership, and role workflows on the deployed candidate.
prerequisites: Isolated owner, editor, viewer, invited, revoked, and expired accounts are available.
controls.expectedObservation: Every account and project workflow reaches the specified durable state and every unauthorized path fails closed.

controls.controlObjective: Prove Import, File, Knowledge, Export, and isolated Preview workflows and their failure recovery.
prerequisites: Real target storage, scanner, parser, knowledge, browser, and approved external provider integrations are active.
controls.expectedObservation: Every content workflow and failure path reaches the specified durable, authorized, checksum-bound state.

controls.controlObjective: Prove Run, SSE, approval, cancel, retry, Canvas, Prototype Patch, and Artifact workflows on the deployed candidate.
prerequisites: A real provider and isolated projects with document, data, design, and prototype fixtures are available.
controls.expectedObservation: Every workflow preserves sequence, identity, authorization, idempotency, and immutable publication invariants.

controls.controlObjective: Prove the complete product matrix emits no unexpected browser console errors.
prerequisites: Console capture is enabled for every G11 browser and viewport cell.
controls.expectedObservation: Unexpected console error count is zero.

controls.controlObjective: Prove the complete product matrix emits no unexpected failed network requests.
prerequisites: Network capture is enabled for every G11 browser and viewport cell.
controls.expectedObservation: Unexpected failed network request count is zero.
